test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about plant tissues is INCORRECT?

options.text: Phloem transports food from leaves to other parts of the plant.
Materials can move in both directions in xylem.
Xylem and phloem are complex tissues.

solution:
The correct answer is **Materials can move in both directions in xylem.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Phloem** indeed transports food from leaves to other parts of the plant, facilitating the distribution of nutrients.
 
• Materials cannot move in both directions in **xylem**; it is specifically designed for unidirectional flow, moving water and minerals from roots to the rest of the plant.
 
• **Xylem and phloem** are classified as complex tissues due to their composition of different types of cells performing a variety of functions.
 
• **Xylem** plays a crucial role in transporting water and minerals absorbed by the roots to various parts of the plant.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Plant Tissue
 Function
 
 
 
 

 **Xylem**
 Transports water and minerals from roots to shoots and leaves
 
 

 **Phloem**
 Transports sugars and other metabolic products downwards from the leaves
 
 

 **Meristematic Tissue**
 Responsible for the growth of plant tissues and organs
 
 

 **Epidermal Tissue**
 Forms the outer protective covering of the plant
 
 

 **Ground Tissue**
 Performs photosynthesis, stores plant products, and helps support the plant
